title: Child Development: Infant/Toddler
award: Certificate of Achievement requiring 8S/12Q to fewer than 16S/24Q units

program.section_heading: Child Development: Infant/Toddler - Certificate of Achievement (12-17 units)
outcomes: Identify developmentally appropriate curriculum and explain principles and practices pertaining to child development.
Examine the connections among child, families, and communities in child development.
Apply a variety of effective approaches, strategies and techniques supporting positive relationships with infants, toddlers and adults.
Create an environment with developmentally appropriate materials and activities for infants and toddlers.
Demonstrate appropriate and effective guidance and teaching strategies in early childhood education.
